verdict.rationale: Unreal Engine provides multiple documented scriptable interfaces relevant to programmatic control: Python scripting for editor automation (asset management, custom UIs, pipelines), a Remote Control API (REST/WebSocket) to call Blueprint-callable functions and expose properties remotely, command-line arguments for build/cook automation, and Unreal Automation Tool/Build Tool for triggering builds. This covers scene/property editing, remote invocation, and build triggering in a documented way suitable for agent-driven automation. However, evidence does not show a unified, AI-agent-oriented interface (e.g., no MCP server, no explicit examples of an autonomous agent scripting node graphs or Blueprint creation end-to-end), and community evidence shows friction/complexity in scripting workflows (e.g., 'My main problem with UE is C++', blueprint limitations). missing for 10: explicit agent-orchestration examples or SDK tailored to AI agents, independent hands-on validation of Python/Remote Control API for full scene/node creation, evidence of an AI-native or MCP-style integration layer.
